title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers

in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.

SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN's growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.

Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN's business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN's market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN's various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.

In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN's corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.

Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN's commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN's senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN's market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN's network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN's market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company's overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management's reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL

BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.

Our mission is to transform people's lives for the better. We don't hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.

Our message to the world is simple – make everyone's life healthier and longer with help of BGI.

Why joining us?

Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.

Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.

Why do we want you?

We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI's values, products and services. And that's why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.

Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:

1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.

Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.

Competences:

a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.

Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners' physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.

Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.

· What do we offer?

1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.

Let's move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Analista de crédito sênior (Motor de Crédito)
description:
A área de Comercial de Crédito e Serviço é responsável pelo fomento comercial, desenvolvimento de produtos, ações comerciais e capacitação das cooperativas centrais e singulares do Sicoob para os produtos de crédito, sejam eles geridos pelas cooperativas ou CCS.

Atividades:

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas e normas de crédito, assegurando aderência às regras de negócio, apetite de risco e exigências regulatórias;
  • Gerenciar as políticas de crédito no motor de decisão, incluindo criação, parametrização, revisão, implantação e versionamento de regras e estratégias;
  • Analisar dados para monitoramento da decisão massiva de crédito, avaliando performance, consistência e eficiência dos fluxos automatizados;
  • Gerir a esteira de crédito, alçadas de aprovação e exceções, garantindo fluidez operacional e governança do processo decisório;
  • Manter a governança e guarda da documentação de políticas, normas, regras, modelos e fluxos de decisão;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de crédito (taxa de aprovação, motivos de recusa, inadimplência, rentabilidade, entre outros), identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização;
  • Estruturar, manter e evoluir modelos de crédito, scorecards e variáveis preditivas, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e de machine learning;
  • Propor e implementar evoluções no motor de crédito, incluindo ajustes de regras, estratégias, fluxos de decisão e integrações com fontes de dados internas e externas;
  • Realizar análises exploratórias de dados (EDA), monitoramento de performance de carteiras e indicadores de risco (PD, LGD, EAD, approval rate, inadimplência etc.);
  • Garantir o monitoramento contínuo e a recalibração de modelos e políticas de crédito, com base em desempenho e mudanças de cenário;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com os times de Dados, Produto, Tecnologia, Compliance e Jurídico, assegurando eficiência operacional e conformidade regulatória;
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas por meio de estudos analíticos, de impacto e simulações de cenários;
  • Documentar metodologias, modelos, políticas e decisões, garantindo auditabilidade, rastreabilidade e boas práticas de governança.

Requisitos

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de Administração, Matemática, Economia, Informática ou Engenharia;
  • MBA em Risco de Crédito/Banking; Data Science Aplicado a Finanças, áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel ou Power BI;
  • Certificação ou certificado de curso avançado em Power BI ou Excel;
  • Experiência com criação de políticas de crédito;
  • Experiência em risco de crédito;
  • Experiência com motor de crédito;
  • Conhecimento em SQL.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Databricks.

title: Analista de Finanças e Operações
description:
Resumo da posição

Tipo de contratação: CLT

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Finanças e Operações (Pleno) para assumir, com autonomia, a operação de NF-e (entrada, saída/venda e importação) e rotinas financeiras operacionais que suportam faturamento, conformidade e fechamento. É uma vaga de execução com método: checklist, evidências e rastreabilidade, com escalonamento apenas por exceção.

Responsabilidades

NF-e e faturamento (ponta a ponta)

  • Emissão de NF-e de saída/venda (faturamento): emissão, autorização, correções, reemissões e rotinas associadas (cancelamento/CC-e quando aplicável).
  • Emissão de NF-e de entrada: recebimentos e ajustes conforme cenários padrão.
  • Operação de NF-e ligada à importação: emissão e/ou conferência operacional com base em DI/DUIMP, Invoice, Packing List e despesas acessórias (no nível necessário para suportar emissão e consistência documental).

Operações financeiras (Finance Ops)

  • Pré-processamento de pagamentos: coleta/validação de documentos suporte, organização de evidências e checagem de aprovações para execução pelo responsável final.
  • Classificação de transações conforme COA gerencial e padrões internos.
  • Gestão de pendências/missing payments (follow-up, status e reprocessos).
  • Apoio ao fechamento operacional: organização de pastas do período, evidências, checklists e amarrações básicas.

Controles e consistência (nível operacional)

  • Controles e conciliações operacionais entre NF-e movimentos/estoque registros contábeis (quando aplicável ao processo).
  • Organização de bases de controle (Excel/SharePoint) com disciplina de data quality (campos críticos, duplicidades e completude).
Requisitos (obrigatórios)
  • Experiência prática com emissão de NF-e de saída/venda (faturamento) e NF-e de entrada.
  • Experiência prática em NF-e ligada à importação (emissão ou conferência operacional com DI/DUIMP).
  • Excel sólido e disciplina de checklist/controle documental.
  • Perfil organizado, orientado a processo e com boa comunicação para follow-up com áreas internas e contabilidade por exceção.
Diferenciais
  • Rotina completa de correções: devoluções, remessas, bonificações e ajustes (quando aplicável).
  • Vivência com cadastros mínimos que suportam emissão (ex.: NCM/CFOP por cenário e parâmetros essenciais).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados e com alta exigência de rastreabilidade documental.

title: Analista Contábil Sênior
description:
Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

ATIVIDADES A SEREM DESENVOLVIDAS

  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo suporte técnico e documentação de suporte;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos contábeis e controles internos;
  • Desenvolver e manter controles internos contábeis, alinhados às práticas de compliance e governança corporativa.

  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis.

description:

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados em Airflow/MWAA, utilizando Python e SQL, seguindo boas práticas de modularidade, testes e versionamento.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (arquitetura medallion) em S3 + Glue Data Catalog, definindo partições, formatos (Parquet/Delta) e tabelas otimizadas para consulta.

  • Publicar e manter datasets confiáveis para Power BI, incluindo incremental refresh, agregações e uso eficiente de DirectQuery/Import em Redshift.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Domínio em Python e SQL avançado.
  • Vivência com Power BI (modelagem semântica, DAX, incremental refresh, gateway, consumo de Redshift).
  • Experiência com arquitetura Data Lakehouse (medallion, Bronze/Silver/Gold, Parquet, partições e metadados).
  • Boas práticas de engenharia: Git, testes, code reviews, documentação, pipelines confiáveis.
  • Conhecimento em segurança e governança de dados (IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Spark/EMR, Glue ETL (PySpark), dbt para Redshift, Redshift Serverless.
  • Conhecimento em Lake Formation, Athena, CloudWatch, ferramentas de qualidade de dados (Great Expectations/Deequ).
  • Experiência com otimização de custo/performance, compaction, partition pruning, materializações e agregações para Power BI.
  • Vivência com Terraform/CloudFormation (IaC).

title: Analista (a) Storage - Híbrido
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

STORAGE JOB DESCRIPTION:

  • Advanced English
  • Good Knowledge on components and architectures.
  • In depth understanding of the HPE Alletra, HP 3PAR, Nimble.
  • Hands on experience with storage array migrations.
  • Experience in SAN storage backup and recovery and exposure to SAN Data replication tools.
  • Experience on Cisco and Brocade fabric switch/Directors. Configuring new switch, upgrades, zoning, VSAN and troubleshooting.
  • Experience of SAN allocation, deallocation.
  • Good Knowledge on RAID concepts, inline data deduplication, inline data compression.
  • Dynamic LUN Provisioning, Zoning, storage firmware upgrades
  • Allocating Boot luns in VMware environment
  • Troubleshooting storage related and compatibility related issues.
  • Allocating LUNs to different operating systems like MS Windows, VMWare ESX/ESXi, Linux and Solaris/AIX/HPUX.
  • Exposure to performance tuning techniques for SAN and NAS
  • Experience in handling major incident bridges, critical issues.
  • Good in scripting and automating the standard storage procedures.
  • Should be familiar with ITIL processes.

Roles & Responsibilities – Storage (HPE 3PAR / Alletra)

1. Design, architect, and deploy HPE 3PAR and Alletra storage solutions based on customer business, performance, and availability requirements.

2. Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workload needs and propose optimal storage designs.

3. Manage 3PAR/Alletra arrays including CPGs, virtual volumes, VLUNs, host sets, and port configurations.

4. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex storage, SAN, and performance issues.

5. Plan and execute storage migrations using Peer Motion, Online Import, and host-based migration tools with minimal downtime.

6. Administer and troubleshoot SAN fabrics (Brocade/Cisco) including zoning, ISLs, firmware upgrades, and fabric resiliency.

7. Optimize storage performance and efficiency through RAID selection, tiering, chunklet layout, and adaptive optimization.

8. Implement and manage replication and DR solutions such as Remote Copy, Peer Persistence, and metro cluster configurations.

9. Integrate storage with virtualization and OS platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Linux, Windows) and resolve multipathing issues.

10. Manage firmware, OS, and controller upgrades ensuring non-disruptive operations and rollback readiness.

11. Leverage HPE InfoSight and SSMC for proactive monitoring, capacity forecasting, and health analysis.

12. Coordinate with backup teams and customers to integrate storage with Commvault / NetBackup for application-consistent backups.

13. Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers on storage architecture, performance analysis, and solution proposals.

14. Provide regular operational and executive-level reports covering capacity utilization, performance trends, risks, and recommendations.

15. Act as escalation point for critical production incidents and major outages.

16. Collaborate with application, database, network, and virtualization teams to align storage design with end-to-end solutions.

17. Ensure security, compliance, and governance through encryption, RBAC, audit logging, and best-practice controls.

18. Automate and standardize storage operations using CLI, REST APIs, and scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.

19. Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review change requests, SOPs, and implementation plans.

20. Participate in CAB meetings, customer reviews, and vendor engagements (HPE) while supporting 24×7 mission-critical environments.

description:

Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You'll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Analista de Supply Chain Jr | Centro de Distribuição
description:
A Estrella Galicia

Somos uma empresa familiar, 100% independente desde 1906. Cultivamos o espírito artesano, mantendo vivos os valores inegociáveis e a paixão da Família Rivera. Nascemos na Galícia e chegamos até aqui sem perder as raízes, que se fortalecem há 5 gerações de cervejeiros. Somos artesanos e nossa arte é fazer cerveja a fogo lento, sem pressa.

Isso é Big Craft.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por 5 pilares:

Cuidado com as pessoas e nosso planeta: Valorizamos, desenvolvemos e reconhecemos nossas pessoas. Somos fortalecidos pela diversidade e respeitamos as pessoas do jeito que elas são.

Orientação para resultados: Somos engajados e comprometidos em atingir nossos resultados. Somos inconformados e obstinados na busca pela excelência. Conhecemos a nossa missão e pavimentamos nosso caminho com agilidade e proatividade, sem perder o foco.

Paixão pelo que somos e fazemos: Somos apaixonados pela nossa origem, história e cervejas. Superamos os desafios do dia-a-dia com entusiasmo e resiliência. Comemoramos e celebramos nossas conquistas e evolução.

Compromisso com nossos stakeholders: Geramos valor por meio de soluções inovadoras. Zelamos pelas nossas conexões, fortalecemos vínculos e desenvolvemos relações de benefício mútuo.

Integridade em nossas ações: Nossas decisões e condutas são orientadas pela ética, respeito e transparência. Atuamos de forma colaborativa e estamos aqui para fazer o que é correto, sem atalhos.

Em 2026, seguimos com todas as oportunidades como vagas intencionais para grupos minorizados.

Como será o seu dia a dia?

Você irá atuar no suporte administrativo e operacional do Centro de Distribuição, garantindo a conferência física e contábil dos produtos, a acuracidade de estoques, o correto processo de faturamento e a integridade das informações logísticas, contribuindo para a eficiência da operação e o cumprimento dos prazos.

O que esperamos de você?

Formação: Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia em Centro de Distribuição, logística ou operações de estoque;

Conhecimento básico de faturamento e documentação fiscal;

Excel intermediário;

Familiaridade com ERP (preferencialmente Datasul – Totvs);

Noções de CFOP, tipos de nota fiscal e fluxo de expedição;

Experiência com inventários e controle de estoque;

Vivência em operações logísticas de bens de consumo;

Conhecimento de indicadores de acuracidade e perdas.

Principais Responsabilidades

Conferência & Inventário

  • Realizar a conferência física e contábil de produtos no recebimento e na expedição, garantindo acuracidade;
  • Validar quantidades, lotes, códigos, avarias e documentação;
  • Executar inventários físicos, gerais e cíclicos;
  • Identificar e reportar divergências de estoque, apoiando ajustes conforme procedimento interno;

Faturamento & Documentação

  • Emitir e conferir notas fiscais de saída, conforme pedidos, rotas e clientes;
  • Validar CFOP (Código Fiscal de Operações e Prestações), volumes, pesos e informações fiscais básicas;
  • Apoiar o fluxo de expedição com liberação correta da documentação;
  • Organizar e arquivar documentos fiscais e operacionais, físicos e/ou digitais.

Rotina Administrativa do CD

  • Acompanhar entradas (inbound) e coletas (outbound) dos produtos.
  • Planejar as atividades diárias de carregamentos, distribuição e faturamento de produtos no CD.
  • Manter comunicação eficaz e integrar as equipes de operação do CD, clientes e parceiros, a fim de garantir o alinhamento de toda a cadeia.
  • Analisar processos operacionais para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, propondo e implementando ações para otimização de recursos.
  • Elaborar, monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance (KPIs) logísticos, como OTIF (On Time In Full) e acuracidade do inventário, entre outros.
  • Interface com áreas como Logística, Fiscal, Transporte e Comercial.
  • Seguir procedimentos internos e padrões de controle.

Qual será sua carga horária, modelo e local de trabalho?

  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial
  • Local: Nova Iguaçu/RJ

Nossos benefícios

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Vale Alimentação/Refeição - Caju Benefícios (utilização em restaurantes e supermercados)

Wellhub/Gympass

Licença parentalidade

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte/Estacionamento

Convênio SESC

PPR de até 1 salário ao ano (sujeito ao atingimento de metas e proporcional ao tempo trabalhado)

Dia de Estrella (day off no mês de aniversário)

Ferramentas de trabalho:

  • Notebook
  • Celular (quando aplicável à posição)

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo (todas classificatórias)

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve, caso esteja alinhado ao nosso perfil.

Entrevista com o RH: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com um representante do RH, com o objetivo de apresentar nossa cultura e o desafio que está sendo proposto e, ao mesmo tempo, apresentar a sua trajetória e momento profissional.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas habilidades técnicas! É também a oportunidade para você conhecer a estrutura, esclarecer possíveis dúvidas, aprofundar nos detalhes do desafio.

Entrevista com Pares: Nesta etapa você terá um papo com pares da liderança direta. Essas conversas nos ajudam a eliminar possíveis viéses. Também é uma oportunidade de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças e valores, nosso jeito de pensar e visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Seja qual for o resultado, todos os candidatos participantes do processo são comunicados sobre a evolução em cada etapa.

E aí? Curtiu? Então não deixe de se inscrever!

title: Digital Designer (Marketing)

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Temos uma cultura de expansão, crescemos todos anos. Estamos no Brasil todo. Você pode crescer muito mais em uma empresa em ascensão como a nossa.

Atualmente contamos com mais de 5.000 processos ativos em 14 áreas de atuação, realizando um atendimento de cerca de mais de 7.000 pessoas todos os meses por todo o Brasil.

Nossa equipe está com quase 50 colaboradores. Estamos acelerando a empresa e buscamos uma pessoa qualificada para nos ajudar a alcançar as metas.

Temos uma equipe de alta performance, e atualmente estamos com:

+5.000 processos ativos (fora os arquivados)

+85.000 novos leads por ano

+10 anos de experiência jurídica

+40 colaboradores na equipe

---------------

Detalhes sobre a vaga

  • Temos um software de CRM funil de vendas (Pipedrive) que permite registrar informações chave para facilitar criar o relacionamento
  • Já temos os leads gerados
  • O time comercial é estruturado em qualificador, fechador e pós-venda
  • Esta vaga é focada em vendas/fechador. Identificar as objeções e garantir o contrato.
  • Não gerará leads, não qualificará os leads, não fará pós-vendas depois de fechado o contrato
  • O foco é especializar para ganhar eficiência
  • No entanto, não temos cultura de braço curto. "Isso não faz parte da minha vaga" não existe aqui
  • Meta é inegociável, tem que ser batida

---------------

Candidato ideal

Há tipos diferentes de perfil de lead potencial, por isto é essencial que você tenha:

  • Capacidade analítica para entender qual lead fecha contrato e qual não fecha;
  • Capacidade analítica para entender o motivo do lead não ter fechado e ir participando da melhoria do script. Não basta apenas ligar usando o mesmo script sem entender o que está acontecendo
  • Capacidade de criar relatórios (o próprio software de vendas possui modelos prontos), com o objetivo de entender qual perfil fecha mais ou menos para focar no melhor perfil de cliente
  • Desenvolver relacionamento a fundo com clientes (rapport, aprender sobre o cliente)
  • Entender a necessidade do cliente e não apenas insistir na venda, mas construir relacionamento

---------------

Qualificações

  • 3+ anos de experiência em vendas
  • Excelente skill de comunicação
  • Habilidade de se auto-organizar e de priorização de trabalho (qual perfil de lead fecha mais e focar nestes)
  • Capacidade de analisar dados, fazer relatórios e tirar conclusões de métricas de vendas

---------------

Local

Alphaville

100% presencial

10h as 19h

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product's end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.

Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Financial Operations Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join the Credix Finance team. The mission of this role is to ensure the operational backbone of our Capital Markets structure runs without errors. You will be responsible for the daily execution of critical tasks - specifically the "plumbing" of our credit operations (CERC registration, document signing) and treasury flows (disbursements and reconciliations).

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Finance, or a related field.
  • Operational Process: Familiarity with back-office routines (payments, reconciliations, file management).
  • Data: Strong ability to organize data, use SQL and Excel, and maintain error-free spreadsheets.
  • Basic Financial Concepts: Understanding of what a receivable is, basic debits/credits, and bank reconciliation.
  • Platform Savvy: Comfort learning new software quickly (e.g., CERC portals, banking platforms, internal admin tools).
  • Extreme Attention to Detail: The ability to spot a 1-cent difference in a reconciliation or a typo in a document contract.
  • Process-Oriented: Enjoys following checklists and finding ways to make repetitive tasks more efficient.
  • Communication: Not afraid to "raise the hand" and escalate issues immediately when something doesn't look right.
  • Ownership: Treats every payment and document as if it were their own money/company.
  • Curiosity: Eager to learn how the financial machine works "under the hood."

Responsibilities

  • Execute the smooth assignment of credit rights to the SEC/FIDC, utilizing internal tooling, CERC, and document signing processes.
  • Manage and monitor all lifecycle events including repurchases, cancellations, and transfers between SEC and FIDC with zero operational errors.
  • Establish and maintain strong daily operational relationships with stakeholders to facilitate mutual support.
  • Evaluate and recommend financial tools to improve efficiency and accuracy, as well as explore new tools that might better suit our evolving needs.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you'll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that's just the beginning - here's what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you're well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Economist, Latin America
description:
Summary of Primary Role

The Economist will play a vital role in supporting our sales pipelines, driving client engagement, and producing data-driven insights that impact on our target markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support sales pipelines through data-driven insight production and client meetings in Latin America, both in the Colombia and Brazil offices.
  • Attend client meetings alongside our sales teams for strategic opportunities.
  • Produce regular data-driven economic insights and dashboards aligned with CEIC's go-to-market plan target addressable markets.
  • Support global insight production through team collaboration and global editorial calendar with thematic cross-region and global economic insights.
  • Support the delivery of the regional community engagement plan.
  • Contribute to marketing activities related to the development of the company's brand awareness and thought leadership in Latin America countries through preparation of content and participation marketing and public speaking initiatives.

To be considered for this role you will need to have:

  • A degree in Economics or Finance.
  • Prior experience with macroeconomic, industry and financial data, with a focus on Latin America.
  • Excellent analytical capabilities working with large data sets with rigorous attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in front of a large audience.
  • Experience writing research publications.
  • Ability to work well in a team, showing excellent team spirit; strong organizational skills are essential.
  • Experience in programming languages applied to economics (R, Python, etc)
  • Fluency in English. Experience writing English-language analytical publications.
  • Spanish speaking is a plus.
  • Positive attitude and a "can do" approach.

What We Offer:

  • Full time employment contract
  • Open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Excellent remuneration package
  • Flexible working culture and hybrid working model

How to Apply:

If you are looking for interesting and challenging job, please, do not hesitate to apply and send your CV in English.

All job applicants will be treated with strict confidentiality. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

About ISI Markets:

ISI Markets is the most comprehensive source of trusted data and actionable insight on emerging and developed markets. We provide the intelligence and insights to act with confidence in the world's highest potential and fastest growing markets. ISI Markets is comprised of four brands (CEIC, EPFR, EMIS and REDD) that share a common purpose to illuminate the opportunity in emerging and developed markets where information can be hard to obtain and even harder to rely upon. We leverage deep local knowledge, well established networks and leading-edge software and advanced analytics to deliver intelligence that informs our clients' investment, strategic and risk decisions.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:

Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.

We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‐generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‐time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‐gen quality while meeting sprint‐based production needs.

We're looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You'll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‐inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Execute high‐quality real‐time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‐game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‐energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‐gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‐loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.

About the Project:

This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‐gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:

  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‐level VFX support.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.

Requirements

  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.

description:
About Woodgrove

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. title: Estagiário(a) de Pedagogia
description:
Position: Pedagogy Intern

Section: Early Childhood Education

Application deadline: February 7, 2026

Start date: Immediate

Main Responsibilities: Assist in the pedagogical activities of the early childhood education section. Support teachers with pedagogical and social activities focused on student development and individual needs. Assist in supervising students in the classroom and in inclusion activities planned by the team.

Requirements: Bilingual in Portuguese and English. Enrolled as a Pedagogy student. Availability to work for at least 1 year. Experience working with children is a differential. Strong identification with the vision, mission, and values of the school. Good planning, organization, and time management skills.

About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá'í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.

Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.

In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.

Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.

School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12o ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.

Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.

Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.

A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.

A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Analista Financeiro - PCD

Nosso compromisso com a inclusão

Esta vaga é direcionada a profissionais PCD, reforçando nosso compromisso com diversidade, acessibilidade e equidade. Acreditamos que múltiplas perspectivas constroem ambientes mais fortes, inovadores e humanos.

title: Quality Manager - Wind Project Delivery
description:
Quality Manager LATAM - Wind Projects

  • Based in São Paulo, Brazil
  • Full time position, hybrid work set-up

The Quality Manager is responsible for establishing, implementing, and overseeing quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) systems for onshore wind projects. This role ensures that all construction, installation, and commissioning activities comply with company standards, contractual requirements, OEM specifications, and Brazilian regulations.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain the project quality management plan, procedures, and inspection & test plans (ITPs) for wind farm projects.
  • Lead site QA/QC activities across civil works, foundations, towers, nacelles, blades, electrical balance of plant, and substations.
  • Coordinate and supervise inspections, tests, and audits; ensure proper documentation, non-conformance reporting (NCR), and timely corrective actions.
  • Review and approve quality documentation from EPCs, subcontractors, and OEMs (method statements, welding procedures, material certificates, FAT/SAT reports).
  • Monitor construction and installation quality, ensuring work is executed according to drawings, specifications, and OEM standards.
  • Manage NCRs, root cause analyses, and preventive measures; track and close punch lists and quality-related defects.
  • Interface with engineering, HSE, construction management, and suppliers to resolve quality issues and improve processes.
  • Ensure traceability and proper record keeping of materials, inspections, and tests for handover to operations and for warranty purposes.
  • Prepare regular quality reports (KPIs, NCR trends, audit findings) for senior management and project stakeholders.
  • Provide training and guidance to site teams and subcontractors on quality standards, procedures, and best practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) or related discipline.
  • Several years of experience in QA/QC or quality management within wind, power generation, or large infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of quality management systems (e.g. ISO 9001) and relevant standards for civil, mechanical, and electrical works.
  • Familiarity with wind turbine technology, foundations, lifting/installation processes, and HV/MV systems.
  • Experience leading audits, inspections, and managing NCR and corrective action processes.
  • Proficient in technical documentation, reporting, and use of digital quality/inspection tools.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills; able to challenge and support contractors constructively.
  • Fluency in English ideal

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer

We're looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who's ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you'll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.

You'll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you're eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos / Human Resources Analyst
description:
G Mining Services é uma empresa multidisciplinar que oferece serviços profissionais ao setor de mineração, atuando em projetos subterrâneos e a céu aberto com metais preciosos, básicos e industriais. Reconhecida como uma das principais consultorias em engenharia de minas do Canadá e entre as mais renomadas em projetos internacionais, a G Mining está expandindo e consolidando sua presença no Brasil. Após o sucesso do projeto da Mina de Tocantinzinho, a empresa está abrindo um novo escritório no país para colaborar com talentos locais em futuros projetos no Brasil e no exterior.

Como empresa familiar, a G Mining valoriza seus colaboradores, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal por meio de oportunidades únicas de carreira, incentivo à colaboração e um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor, seguro e inclusivo.

Analista de Recursos Humanos

Resumo da Posição

O(a) profissional atuará como Analista de Recursos Humanos, apoiando a operação local e contribuindo para a consolidação da estrutura organizacional da empresa no Brasil. Será responsável por garantir a execução eficiente das rotinas de RH e por fortalecer a cultura corporativa, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, ético e alinhado aos valores globais da G Mining Services.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar todo o ciclo de recrutamento e seleção, desde a divulgação das vagas até o onboarding.
  • Manter e atualizar registros e contratos de colaboradores (CLT e prestadores de serviço).
  • Apoiar nas rotinas de folha de pagamento, controle de ponto, férias, benefícios e rescisões.
  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos (saúde, odontológico, alimentação, transporte e seguro de vida), incluindo controles mensais, inclusões e exclusões.
  • Apoiar nas relações trabalhistas e garantir conformidade com a legislação brasileira (CLT).
  • Apoiar na organização e execução de ações de integração, treinamentos e iniciativas de engajamento.
  • Contribuir com ideias e auxiliar na implementação de programas de bem-estar e cultura que fortaleçam a experiência do colaborador.
  • Preparar relatórios e indicadores de RH (headcount, benefícios, custos de pessoal etc.) para suporte à gestão.
  • Colaborar com as equipes globais de RH e Administração, mantendo uma comunicação eficaz em inglês.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas generalistas de RH.
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação trabalhista (CLT) e práticas administrativas de RH.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado, para comunicação frequente com equipes internacionais.
  • Boa habilidade com Excel e ferramentas do Microsoft Office.

Perfil desejado

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade e atitude colaborativa.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Empatia, integridade e genuíno interesse por pessoas.
  • Flexibilidade e perfil "mão na massa".

Informações Adicionais

A posição será baseada no escritório da G Mining Services em Belo Horizonte, Brasil. A empresa busca profissionais dinâmicos e motivados que desejam integrar uma equipe experiente e comprometida com o sucesso de seus projetos.

Benefícios

  • Bônus por desempenho individual e corporativo.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para colaboradores e familiares.
  • Reembolso de atividades esportivas.
  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Atividades sociais e de integração.

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

G Mining Services is a multidisciplinary company that provides professional services to the mining sector, working on both open-pit and underground projects involving precious, base, and industrial metals. Recognized as one of Canada's leading mining engineering consultancies and among the most respected in international projects, G Mining is expanding and strengthening its presence in Brazil.

Following the success of the Tocantinzinho Mine project, the company is opening a new office in the country to collaborate with local talent on future projects in Brazil and abroad.

As a family-owned company, G Mining values its employees by promoting both professional and personal development through unique career opportunities, collaboration, and a welcoming, safe, and inclusive work environment.

Human Resources Analyst

Position Summary

The professional will serve as a Human Resources Analyst, supporting local operations and contributing to the consolidation of the company's organizational structure in Brazil. They will be responsible for ensuring the efficient execution of HR routines and for strengthening the corporate culture, fostering a collaborative, ethical, and value-driven work environment aligned with G Mining Services' global standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the entire recruitment and selection cycle, from job posting to onboarding.
  • Maintain and update employee records and contracts (CLT and service providers).
  • Assist with payroll, time tracking, vacation, benefits, and termination processes.
  • Administer corporate benefits (health, dental, meal, transportation, and life insurance), including monthly controls, enrollments, and removals.
  • Support labor relations and ensure compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT).
  • Organize and execute integration, training, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Contribute ideas and assist in implementing wellness and culture programs that enhance the employee experience.
  • Prepare HR reports and metrics (headcount, benefits, personnel costs, etc.) to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with global HR and Administration teams, maintaining effective communication in English.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in generalist HR routines.
  • Solid knowledge of labor legislation (CLT) and HR administrative practices.
  • Intermediate to advanced English level for frequent communication with international teams.
  • Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office tools.

Desired Profile

  • Organization and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Empathy, integrity, and genuine interest in people.
  • Flexibility and hands-on mindset.

Additional Information

The position will be based at G Mining Services' office in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. The company seeks dynamic and motivated professionals who wish to join an experienced team committed to project success.

Benefits

  • Individual and corporate performance bonuses.
  • Health and dental plans for employees and their families.
  • Reimbursement for sports activities.
  • Training and professional development programs.
  • Social and integration activities.

title: Gerente de Serviços - Husqvarna Construção

Seu papel será liderar o time de serviços técnicos, garantindo excelência em reparos, suporte, treinamentos e melhoria contínua dos processos que sustentam nossa operação de pós-venda na Divisão de Construção.

title: Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Truck Center - Inovação em Sistemas
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Truck Center é uma empresa paranaense com mais de 35 anos de atuação no desenvolvimento de equipamentos e softwares automotivos para alinhamento, balanceamento e serviços de pneus em veículos leves e pesados. Com forte foco em tecnologia, precisão e melhoria contínua, a empresa se destaca pelo compromisso com inovação e qualidade, oferecendo soluções completas que incluem fabricação, treinamento e suporte técnico. Diante disso, a Truck Center busca avançar em novos desafios, especialmente na criação de sistemas mais modernos e integrados para alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.

Projeto: Inovação em sistemas de alinhamento, balanceamento e calibração automotiva.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Mecatrônica, Eletrônica, Física ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

  • Testes funcionais dos equipamentos em oficina piloto;

  • Produção de manuais técnicos.

  • Conhecimento de ferramentas CAD/CAE Python, sistemas embarcados integração de sensores e sistemas.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos sobre under car, tanto da linha leve como da linha pesada, sistemas de alinhamento e geometria de veículos e balanceamento de rodas.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on HR Business Partner based in Brazil to support our fast-growing local team.

This role is highly execution-focused, with a strong emphasis on recruitment (50%), while also covering employee relations & compliance, culture building, and basic office administration.

You will work closely with local business leaders and our global HQ, acting as a trusted partner who can move fast, get things done, and grow with the business.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition (50%)

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for the Brazil team, including roles in operations, live streaming hosts, business development, and support functions
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand business needs and deliver high-quality hires quickly
  • Manage and optimize local recruiting channels (LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, agencies, communities, etc.)
  • Screen, interview, and assess candidates with a strong focus on role fit and potential
  • Track hiring progress and continuously improve recruiting efficiency and candidate experience

Employee Relations & Compliance (25%)

  • Manage employee relations and ensure compliance with Brazilian labor laws and regulations
  • Handle employment contracts, probation periods, terminations, and disciplinary matters
  • Coordinate with external vendors such as payroll providers, accounting firms, and labor lawyers
  • Serve as the first point of contact for employees on HR-related questions and issues
  • Proactively identify and communicate labor risks and compliance updates to HQ

Culture & Organizational Support (15%)

  • Support the localization and implementation of company culture within the Brazil team
  • Drive onboarding, employee engagement, and internal communication initiatives
  • Support people managers with basic people management and cross-cultural collaboration
  • Act as a cultural bridge between the Brazil team and global stakeholders

Administration & Office Support (10%)

  • Support basic office administration and local operational needs
  • Coordinate vendors and ensure a smooth day-to-day office environment
  • Provide flexible support as the business continues to scale

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in HR, preferably in an HRBP or generalist role
  • Strong hands-on experience in recruitment; able to manage multiple roles independently
  • Solid understanding of or strong interest in Brazilian labor law and HR compliance
  • Fluent in Portuguese; working proficiency in English (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Practical, down-to-earth, and willing to roll up sleeves to get things done

What We Offer

  • A fast-growing business with strong momentum and real impact
  • High level of ownership and autonomy in the HR function
  • Close collaboration with senior leadership and global teams
  • Long-term career growth opportunities as the business expands
