title: SAP PMO
description:
Come to one of the largest IT services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS?

Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a SAP PMO who wants to learn and transform their career. In this role is responsible for managing the governance, processes, and resources for SAP projects, ensuring successful delivery by overseeing planning, execution, risk management, stakeholder communication, and adherence to methodologies. The SAP PMO ensures that all projects—whether software, infrastructure, or process-related—follow the same methodology, use the same tools, and report indicators in a standardized way, providing consolidated visibility to senior management.

In this role, you will:

• Standardize Methodologies: Define and update the project management "toolkit" (schedule templates, communication plans, risk matrices) to be used by all Project Managers.

• Governance and Compliance: Ensure that projects follow approval phases and internal processes, guaranteeing compliance with company standards.

• Report Consolidation (Dashboards): Gather data from multiple projects to create executive reports on status, timelines, and overall portfolio health (with no focus on costs).

• Resource and Capacity Management (Capacity Planning): Monitor team workload to identify staffing bottlenecks and help prioritize which project should start first.

• Support and Mentorship: Assist Project Managers and Product Owners in resolving methodological conflicts and using management tools.

• Corporate Risk Management: Identify risks that recur across multiple projects and propose structural actions to eliminate them at their source.

• Continuous Improvement: Analyze lessons learned from completed projects to optimize workflows for future cycles.

Required Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, IT, or related fields.

• Previous experience in project management offices (PMO) or leadership roles in process management.

• Exceptional Organization: Ability to structure large volumes of information from different sources.

• Diplomacy and Impartiality: Skill in auditing projects and pointing out deviations constructively and neutrally.

• Analytical Vision: Ability to identify failure patterns in schedules before they become critical issues.

• Teaching Ability: Skill in training others and explaining methodologies in a simple and applicable way.

• Critical Thinking: Ability to challenge current processes in pursuit of simplification and agility (debureaucratization).

  • Fluent in English

Desired Skills:

• Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or PMO-specific certifications such as those from PMO Global Alliance.

• Portfolio Tools: Proficiency in PPM (Project Portfolio Management) tools such as Asana, Monday.com, MS Project Online, or Jira Software.

• Data Analysis: Knowledge of Power BI for developing KPI dashboards.

title: Estagiário
description:
Oportunidade: Estágio

Nosso escritório, referência em excelência e inovação em soluções jurídicas, está em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) para integrar nossa equipe em Brasília/DF. Esta é uma oportunidade única para você aprofundar seus conhecimentos em gestão jurídica, compreender os processos internos de um escritório de advocacia e desenvolver competências essenciais para sua carreira na área do direito.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Durante seu estágio, você terá a chance de vivenciar na prática como funciona a gestão estratégica de um escritório de advocacia, participando de atividades que abrangem desde o monitoramento de prazos processuais até a análise de dados jurídicos. Você trabalhará ao lado de profissionais experientes, aprendendo não apenas as rotinas administrativas, mas também a lógica por trás dos processos jurídicos e a importância da organização e do controle na advocacia.

Atividades e Aprendizados

Área de Aprendizado

Atividades e Desenvolvimento

Gestão de Prazos e Publicações

Você acompanhará a leitura de publicações, o monitoramento de prazos processuais e intimações eletrônicas, compreendendo como a organização desses dados impacta diretamente no sucesso dos processos.

Sistemas Jurídicos e Análise de Dados

Aprenderá a trabalhar com softwares de gestão jurídica, elaborando relatórios e analisando dados que auxiliam na tomada de decisão estratégica do escritório.

Suporte à Equipe Jurídica

Você colaborará diretamente com advogados e coordenadores, entendendo as demandas práticas da profissão e desenvolvendo habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Perfil Esperado

Buscamos um(a) estudante de Direito que possua:

• Interesse genuíno em compreender a gestão e a organização de escritórios de advocacia.

• Perfil organizado, com atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas.

• Disposição para aprender e crescer, com curiosidade sobre os processos jurídicos.

• Habilidades com ferramentas digitais, especialmente Pacote Office (Excel é um diferencial).

• Comunicação clara e relacionamento interpessoal positivo com a equipe.

O que Você Ganhará

• Experiência Prática: Vivência real de como funciona a gestão interna de um escritório de advocacia, preparando-o(a) para os desafios da profissão.

• Mentoria: Acompanhamento próximo de profissionais experientes que compartilharão seus conhecimentos e orientarão seu desenvolvimento.

• Desenvolvimento de Competências: Aprimoramento de habilidades técnicas (softwares jurídicos, análise de dados) e comportamentais (organização, proatividade, liderança).

• Rede Profissional: Oportunidade de construir relacionamentos valiosos com profissionais da área jurídica.

• Possibilidade de Continuidade: Bom desempenho pode abrir portas para futuras oportunidades de trabalho no escritório.

Informações Adicionais

• Regime de Trabalho: Presencial em nosso escritório em Brasília/DF.

• Como se Candidatar: Interessados(as) devem enviar o currículo para o e-mail com o assunto "Vaga de Estágio".

Venha crescer com a gente! Esta é sua chance de começar uma carreira sólida na advocacia, com aprendizado real e contato direto com profissionais de excelência. Aguardamos sua candidatura!

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.

Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.

Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Analista de suporte
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Suporte de Nível 3 para os usuários da Dexian Brasil;
  • Atualização do controle de ativos de TI (Asset Inventory);
  • Tratativa dos alertas do sistema de Service Desk;
  • Acompanhamento dos contratos de TI;
  • Suporte ao Active Directory;
  • Suporte à ferramenta de Service Desk;
  • Documentação de processos e políticas de TI;
  • Acompanhamento de projetos de TI;
  • Abertura de chamado para o suporte TI da Dexian Global quando houver criação / remoção de usuários do ambiente corporativo Dexian;
  • Tratar da solução de problemas conforme relatado pelos usuários;
  • Criar / revisar processos e documentação de suporte (aplicáveis ao N1);
  • Solucionar problemas analisando a causa raíz e avaliando várias opções;
  • Em caso de eventos de falha, notificar usuários e corrigir o problema ou escalonar para nível superior;
  • Recomendar procedimentos e controles para resolução de problemas ou criar soluções temporárias até que soluções permanentes possam ser implementadas;
  • Documentar o status e a resolução do problema no sistema Service Desk;
  • Instalar, configurar e manter os componentes de hardware e software do sistema aprovados.;
  • Implementar alterações de software ou hardware predeterminadas para retificar quaisquer problemas;
  • Documentar processos técnicos e políticas que envolvam a TI;
  • Solicitação de orçamento para novos equipamentos;
  • Gestão dos contratos de equipamento, quanto a novas necessidades e prazo de devolução;
  • Planejamento e acompanhamento dos projetos relacionados à TI Brasil;
  • Realizar suporte físico e remoto aos usuários, atuando em resolução de dúvidas e problemas de Nível 1, relacionados a infraestrutura, acessos e uso do laptop.
  • Capacidade para executar atividades de manutenção de redes, telefonia, servidores, desktops, notebooks, impressoras, dispositivos móveis, instalação e configuração de softwares em SO Linux e Windows.
  • Atendimento dos chamados recebidos via sistema de ITSM, relacionados ao N1 e N2.

  • Desenvolver estratégias de atendimento às demandas de projetos pontuais, de acordo com a distribuição das demandas feita pelo coordenador, para garantir a qualidade e atendimento dos prazos.

O que você precisa ter

title: Custom Recruitment Specialist (English & German Speaking)
description:
About M3: A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Custom Recruitment Specialist to join M3 Global Research, an M3 company.

About the Business Unit:

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Custom Recruitment Specialist is responsible for creating and executing a Custom Recruitment plan on allocated M3 Experts projects, as well as traditional Qualitative and Quantitative market research projects, ensuring a successful delivery within the provided budget and timelines. This role will directly manage expert and respondent facing recruitment tasks with the aim of increasing the total number of consultations and/or market research completes. This position will also utilize language capabilities as needed to expand the supply of experts primarily in Germany, but also globally.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Including, but not limited to the following:

  • Have an excellent understanding of custom recruitment strategies for M3 Experts studies, as well as traditional qualitative and quantitative studies; collaborate with Project Stakeholders to best utilize available options for maximum results.
  • Demonstrate complete confidence in using all recruitment platforms and tools, such as the MR System, Dotmailer, Call Center, LinkedIn, ClickSend, DNUK, Rekru, Confirmit/Decipher...
  • Attend IKO and project related meetings with PMs for projects assigned and share notes on agreed plan of action.
  • Build a custom recruitment plan for assigned projects always keeping in mind the needs of the client
  • Custom recruit for the expansion of M3's global Expert Network via current client projects and strategic proactive recruitment initiatives.
  • Expand our network of Germany based experts and German speaking experts to meet current and future client demand.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of custom recruitment for all project types, ensuring successful delivery within the budget provided and timelines.
  • Communicate and collaborate across teams and divisions, including Qual, Quant and Sales.
Qualifications

Education and Training Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred
  • Relevant coursework in market research or healthcare preferred but not required.

Language:

  • Fluency in English and German (professional working proficiency)

Minimum Experience:

  • Minimum 2 years' expert network, market research or recruiting experience
  • Prior experience managing client or expert relationships a plus

Knowledge, Skill, Ability:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software

title: Consultor (a) Storage - Híbrido
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

STORAGE JOB DESCRIPTION:

  • Advanced English
  • Good Knowledge on components and architectures.
  • In depth understanding of the HPE Alletra, HP 3PAR, Nimble.
  • Hands on experience with storage array migrations.
  • Experience in SAN storage backup and recovery and exposure to SAN Data replication tools.
  • Experience on Cisco and Brocade fabric switch/Directors. Configuring new switch, upgrades, zoning, VSAN and troubleshooting.
  • Experience of SAN allocation, deallocation.
  • Good Knowledge on RAID concepts, inline data deduplication, inline data compression.
  • Dynamic LUN Provisioning, Zoning, storage firmware upgrades
  • Allocating Boot luns in VMware environment
  • Troubleshooting storage related and compatibility related issues.
  • Allocating LUNs to different operating systems like MS Windows, VMWare ESX/ESXi, Linux and Solaris/AIX/HPUX.
  • Exposure to performance tuning techniques for SAN and NAS
  • Experience in handling major incident bridges, critical issues.
  • Good in scripting and automating the standard storage procedures.
  • Should be familiar with ITIL processes.

Roles & Responsibilities – Storage (HPE 3PAR / Alletra)

1. Design, architect, and deploy HPE 3PAR and Alletra storage solutions based on customer business, performance, and availability requirements.

2. Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workload needs and propose optimal storage designs.

3. Manage 3PAR/Alletra arrays including CPGs, virtual volumes, VLUNs, host sets, and port configurations.

4. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex storage, SAN, and performance issues.

5. Plan and execute storage migrations using Peer Motion, Online Import, and host-based migration tools with minimal downtime.

6. Administer and troubleshoot SAN fabrics (Brocade/Cisco) including zoning, ISLs, firmware upgrades, and fabric resiliency.

7. Optimize storage performance and efficiency through RAID selection, tiering, chunklet layout, and adaptive optimization.

8. Implement and manage replication and DR solutions such as Remote Copy, Peer Persistence, and metro cluster configurations.

9. Integrate storage with virtualization and OS platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Linux, Windows) and resolve multipathing issues.

10. Manage firmware, OS, and controller upgrades ensuring non-disruptive operations and rollback readiness.

title: Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region's most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role:

As a Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist, you will play a vital role in our commitment to implementing best practices in quality control. This position is dedicated to ensuring the highest quality standards in our products through collaboration with suppliers, monitoring quality processes, and enhancing our aftersales services. Your contributions will not only enhance our products and services but also strengthen positive relationships with our customers.Job Description:

  • Collaborate with suppliers to establish clear quality expectations and standards for components and materials.
  • Evaluate suppliers reports to ensure compliance with quality standards and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor the quality processes for incoming materials, documenting and analyzing relevant data and processes.
  • Manage warranty processes with suppliers, including the preparation and submission of technical reports, claims, and supporting documentation.
  • Create detailed reports on product quality metrics and supplier performance, identifying trends and opportunities for enhancement.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to communicate findings and recommend actions that improve product quality and customer satisfaction.

Hard Skills:

  • Experience in quality assurance, supplier management, or a related field within manufacturing or the automotive industry.
  • Proficiency in quality management systems and reporting tools that facilitate effective data analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess product performance and identify recurring quality issues.
  • Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly Disciplined: Demonstrates a strong commitment to accuracy, organization, and consistency in all tasks.
  • Process-Oriented Thinking: Employs systematic thinking to analyze workflows and enhance problem-solving capabilities, ensuring efficiency in processes.
  • Attention to Detail: Conducts thorough evaluations of supplier quality and product performance, focusing on delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Effective Communication Skills: Communicates clearly and concisely with stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual understanding across teams.

description:
No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários (as).

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades das pessoas para as quais prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites;
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação;

.

Nós lhe propomos:
